text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Oguri Cap enters more and more
races, her
fanbase continues to
grow—and that's not the
only kind of
attention she's attracting.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Interviews, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap's recent exploits seem to
have caught
the attention of
reporters—many of whom have

requested an interview with the
up-and-coming
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is a chance to boost her popularity,
so I can't
risk letting it slip away.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I've been
interviewed.
Reporters always used to
speak to me after my
races back home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wish. You know I'm not very good at
speaking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If this is something she struggles with,
there's no
need for her to push herself.
But when I say as
much....

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No. I wanna speak to them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I learn how to express myself better,
people
might start taking me more
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This feels like a crucial moment for me,
so... yeah,
I wanna do the interviews.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel worried seeing
Oguri Cap so
anxious. But since she's
also clearly determined,
we accept all
the interviews.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap! Can you sum up how you feel
about
this race in a few brief words?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh... I'm going to... be the bestest
runner there
is.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, that wraps up today's interview.
Thank
you very much.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you too. ...Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm just a little tired. I'm not used to
speaking
this much. You can call over
the next reporter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since she has time to spare, Oguri Cap
takes on
interview after interview. I can
tell that she's
tired, but she's done great
so far.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the talking is clearly taking a toll on
her, but
with the way things are going,
I'm confident she'll
be able to wrap
these interviews up without a
hitch. No
sooner does the thought cross my mind

than...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...Hi. You're Oguri Cap, right? I'm from
the Racer
Times.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Hm, let's see... So I've heard on the
grapevine
that the residents of your
hometown are a source
of inspiration for
you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Uhh, yes. I... want the folks back home
to see how
hard I work.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...So, what's your ultimate goal? What
kind of
race do you want to run in?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Umm... Well... I...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...Right, I see. Let's go ahead and call it
here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: R-really? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think I've heard more than
enough. I can
see that you aren't a very
driven individual.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Let me give you one piece of advice.
You'll need
more than just hard work if
you want any chance
of coming out on
top in the central races.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine. I'm not upset or anything.
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I saw that! What the heck's goin'
on?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Tama?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's Tamamo Cross, Oguri Cap's
roommate. I hear
they're really close
friends.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That reporter back there was a nasty
piece of
work, huh? Talk about givin'
unwanted advice!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I guess I didn't sound committed
enough.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Oguri, pull yourself together! Ya
really just
gonna let people speak to ya
like that?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Bein' underestimated is the worst! Gets
ya real
riled up, don't it? I bet you're
itchin' to prove 'em
wrong!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The heck? Cat got your tongue? Bein' a
Goody
Two-shoes isn't gonna get ya the
credit that ya
deserve!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya need to be true to yourself and keep
winnin'!
That's the only way you can
make people see ya
for who you are.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's da secret to my success too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross managed to debut even
earlier
than Oguri Cap. She must have
gone through her
own fair share of trials
and tribulations in order to
do so.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're pretty lousy at talkin' to begin
with, and
when ya try to sound good, it's
even worse!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So why bother? Just shut ya trap and
train
instead! Anyway, see ya.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Tamamo Cross leaves just as
quickly as
she appeared.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama's right. Part of me was trying really
hard to
say the right thing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But that's no way to get my feelings
across. That
reporter probably just had
enough of it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, there's something I want you
to do for
me. Will you hear me out?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap asks me to invite all the
reporters who
interviewed her to a press
conference.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming, everyone. There's
something I
want to say to you all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I... want you all to watch me race. I want
you to
see for yourselves how strong I
am.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll live up to your
expectations—I'm
strong like that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm stronger than anyone else in the
Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...That's all. Thank you for your time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere is noticeably different
after her
speech.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Was that a declaration of war? This
Oguri Cap
sure is a force to be reckoned
with!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I need to get back and upload this article right away! It's definitely going to go viral!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap's sincerity has certainly
moved a few
hearts today.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...Geez, guess I have to revise that
article. I
already know what the headline
should be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, the headline "I Am
Strong" is on the
front page of almost
every newspaper.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning alone didn't do much to bring
her into
the spotlight, but now, all eyes
are on Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how she is, I'm sure she'll
leverage this
moment in the limelight to
pull off a big victory! I
can't wait for her
next race!
